claims: The 98th Academy Awards were held on March 15, 2026.
One Battle After Another won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
One Battle After Another was directed by Paul Thomas Anderson.
Sinners was nominated for Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners was directed by Ryan Coogler.

Hamnet was directed by Chloé Zhao.

Bugonia was directed by Yorgos Lanthimos.

Marty Supreme was directed by Josh Safdie.
Sentimental Value was nominated for Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sentimental Value was directed by Joachim Trier.
The Secret Agent was nominated for Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
F1 was nominated for Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
Frankenstein was nominated for Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
Frankenstein was directed by Guillermo del Toro.
